employeeShare.label: Share of full-time employees
employeeShare.definition: Share of Palantir's 3,936 full-time employees who are employed outside of the United States (10-K, Human Capital).

source.label: Palantir Technologies Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, we had 3,936 full-time employees, 31% of whom are employed outside of the United States.

source.label: Palantir Technologies Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, Item 2 Properties
source.quote: We have leased principal properties in Denver, Colorado, which is the location of our corporate headquarters; in Palo Alto, California; New York City, New York; Washington, D.C.; and London, England.
